content: If thunderbird starts at all, there is a profile in place. if all your emails are there and you can send and receive, your profile is alive and well. your profile is stored in c:\users\<<yourid>\appdata\roamimg\thunderbird\profiles You can see the profile by clicking help>troubleshootinginformaition, scroll to 'profile folder' and click 'open folder'
